title: Understanding Health Insurance
description: A comprehensive exploration of health insurance fundamentals—cost-sharing components, plan types, coverage sources, and the critical turning-26 transition—equipping students to make informed healthcare coverage decisions and avoid medical debt.
learning_objectives: Distinguish between key cost-sharing components of a health plan (premium, deductible, copay, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximum)
Compare plan types (HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP) and identify the tradeoffs of each
Explain how employer-sponsored, ACA marketplace, Medicaid/CHIP, and Medicare coverage differ
Describe what happens when a young adult turns 26 and ages off a parent's plan
Evaluate when a high-deductible plan paired with an HSA makes financial sense

skill_builder.title: My Health Insurance Readiness Checklist
skill_builder.description: A personal readiness assessment helping students evaluate their health insurance literacy across five critical areas—from understanding coverage basics to knowing where to find individual coverage when needed.

texas_standards_alignment.texas_pfl: §113.49(c)(12)(B) — evaluate health insurance options including employer-provided and private insurance
